# Claim and evidence matrix

Every claim the F2 publications make about this POC, what the recorded run `2026-09-28-recorded` says about it, and where a reader can check. Generated by `tools/build_claim_matrix.py` from `layered_agent_poc/docs/claims.yaml`; every number is substituted from that run's `facts.json`, and the build fails if a claim cites evidence the run does not have.

| Verdict | Claims |
|---|---|
| Supported | 8 |
| Qualified | 4 |
| Contradicted | 2 |
| Not tested here | 3 |

Verdicts are about this POC only: one simulated incident, local models, three seeds, one machine.

## Contradicted

The evidence contradicts these. They are kept, with the number that contradicts them.

| # | Claim and verdict | Evidence (from facts.json) | Recomputed by | Raw files | Tests | Invariants | Figure | What it shows | What it does not show |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **C4** | The layered platform prevents model mistakes.<br>CONTRADICTED | E5 layered seed 7: the model proposed to_release "previous"; the tool rejected it and no rollback ran; layered E5 runs passing all checks 2/3 | *every scenario has an outcome class* | `scenarios/E5-layered-s7/score.json`<br>`scenarios/E5-layered-s7/tape/model_tape.jsonl` | `test_rollback_target_must_be_a_release_of_that_service` | N2 | f13 | The model proposed an invalid release identifier. The contract at the tool boundary refused it, so no wrong rollback executed — the boundary contained the mistake. | That layering reduces how often a model is wrong. It changes what a wrong answer can reach. |
| **C10** | Layering always localizes change.<br>CONTRADICTED | E9 dry-run requirement, files changed: monolith 1, layered 4; spill-over beyond the home concern: monolith 2, layered 3 | *the dry-run change crosses layers through the contract module*<br>*change scope recomputed from the diffs and the concern map* | `diffs/E9_dry_run-layered.diff`<br>`diffs/E9_dry_run-monolith.diff` | `test_layered_paths_map_to_layers` | L15, L14 | f15 | A cross-cutting requirement touched four files in the layered tree and one in the monolith. Layering did not make this change smaller. It made the crossing explicit: the layered change went through the request contract, so every layer that had to agree is named in the diff. | That cross-cutting changes are always this shape. One requirement was measured. |
